tagline: Gateway to Espíritu Santo — a UNESCO island wilderness reached only by boat.
summary: La Paz, capital of Baja California Sur, is the gateway to Isla Espíritu Santo, a protected UNESCO island group of sea-lion colonies, coves and white-sand beaches reached only by permit-controlled boats. For Navier Experiences it's a premium wilderness-island node; the deep-water Pichilingue terminal handles long-haul Gulf ferries and is context only, not a Navier corridor.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the ~12 nm run to Espíritu Santo comfortably.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) is optional here; the core network is well inside Pioneer II all-electric range.

competitive_landscape: Permit tour operators serve the island; no premium scheduled tier exists.
seasonality: Pacific/Gulf hurricane season (Jun–Nov); whale-shark season (Oct–Apr) is a key draw. Gulf waters are generally protected.
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API/Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR); Espíritu Santo is a protected area with strict permits.
